cohort: 13,792,544 births in the United States from 1999 to 2015, including 1005 births to women with PUD
finding: Pregnant women with PUD were at increased risk of preeclampsia, PPROM, cesarean delivery, venous thromboembolism, maternal death, IUGR, preterm birth, intrauterine fetal death, and congenital anomalies.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more likely in women with PUD (OR 1.60, 95% CI 1.40-1.82).
